title: APO Strip Steak with Caramelized Shallot Gravy
description: Trimmed strip steaks cook in full steam and are sliced into a sherry gravy sweetened with slowly caramelized shallot.
equipment: Anova Precision Oven Gen 1 with food probe, bottom drip pan and middle wire rack

ingredients.name: lean center-cut New York strip steak
ingredients.note: Two lean portions about 3/4 inch thick; weight after removing the fat edge and gristle.

ingredients.name: small shallot
ingredients.note: Slice very thinly; fully caramelize before serving.

ingredients.name: low-sodium beef broth
ingredients.note: Use plain broth made from meat, bones and water without a vegetable seasoning blend.

steps.title: Preheat the APO
steps.text: Fill the water tank and install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 155°F with sous vide mode on, 100% steam, rear element on, top and bottom elements off. Set the food probe target to 145°F.

steps.title: Position the probe
steps.text: Lay {beef} unbagged in the shallow pan on the middle rack. Insert the probe sideways into the thickest center, clear of the pan. Begin cooking immediately and set a separate 20-minute reminder for the first temperature check; respond sooner if the probe signals.

steps.title: Caramelize the shallot
steps.text: While the steaks cook, soften {shallot} in {butter} in the HexClad over medium-low for 20–25 minutes. Stir often, using a splash of {broth} if the pan catches, until the shallot is uniformly soft and golden brown.

steps.title: Deglaze the skillet
steps.text: Stir {vinegar}, {pepper} and the remaining {broth} into the shallots and simmer for 2 minutes. Press the liquid and soft shallots through a fine sieve and return the smooth base to the skillet.

steps.title: Make the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce base to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and keep it bubbling gently for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Steam the steaks
steps.text: Cook in full steam for about 25–50 minutes, checking from 20 minutes. Remove each portion when its center reaches 145°F.

steps.title: Rest in the juices
steps.text: Remove the pan and rest the steaks loosely covered in their juices for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Slice into the gravy
steps.text: Slice the rested steaks thinly across the grain. Lay them in the gravy and divide all the sauce between the plates.

notes: Make ahead: Caramelize the shallot a day ahead and refrigerate. Warm it in the stock while the steaks cook. Option A uses sherry vinegar. For gentler Option B, omit it and round out the gravy with a little more broth. For dairy-free gravy use avocado oil instead of butter. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze thin slices in gravy for up to 6 weeks; some pink color will be lost during reheating. Fridge reheat: Place one portion and its sauce in a shallow covered dish. Install the APO bottom drip pan and preheat to 325°F, sous vide mode off, 60% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Insert the probe in the coldest center and set it to 165°F. Start checking after 12 minutes and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw a single portion in the refrigerator overnight, then use the fridge reheating method. Stir the sauce until smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 250 kcal, 34.8 g protein, 5.1 g total carbohydrate, 10.0 g fat, 0.4 g fiber, 94 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
